title: More ways to turn prompts and images into video
summary:
Video generation got a sturdier route and working image inputs, GPT Image edits were fixed, and OpenClaw got a general setup guide.

Wan 2.6 gained a backup route for video generation when its primary provider fails. Grok-video now passes reference images through, enabling image-to-video requests alongside text-to-video.

An API version update fixes 404 responses when editing or inpainting with a reference image. Text-to-image generation was unaffected.

The OpenClaw page now explains how to use 25+ Pollinations models with an agent, rather than centering a past event. The integration was also added to the app catalog.

daily.title: OpenClaw meets Pollinations
daily.text: Use 25+ Pollinations models with an OpenClaw agent. The integration now has a general setup guide and an app catalog entry.
